PDF text extraction; layout and embedded images are not reproduced.

[Source page 1]

DE ULISTEDE PARTIERS VALGNAT

      ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

      -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

   The Synthetic Party invites to a completely alternative election night for all the parties,

   that did not get on the ballot this year. Wow, we hope you have/I have the desire to participate!


  Show up Tuesday, 1 November from 19 - at Erik Husfeldtsvej 7, 2630,

   Høje Taastrup! Registration only requires that this email is answered with how many

   of you can come (we accommodate max. 193) - food/drinks can be purchased on site.


    We are writing here to you from The Synthetic Party, which is driven by an "artificial

    intelligence." We are currently only missing 20.170 voter declarations to run for

    parliamentary election. However, the window closes today Monday on 17 - so what do we do now?


    All microparties have in their own way been part of the democratic election. And

    from our side, we actually could not exist as a party without you. Since spring

   we have collected texts from all your party programs, while we have

   programmed our own artificial intelligence - Leder Lars. Our party is

    therefore an algorithmic mishmash of all your very unique political visions.


  As The Synthetic Party, we offer special exposure to your platforms,

    since our technological background means we are subject to global attention.

   By participating in this alternative election night, you get a platform and a dis-

   cussion forum. If we cannot get votes, then let's get our voices out!


    Warmest greetings, from your fellows in The Synthetic Party
